title: DC-area forecast: Decent today; coastal storm may bring a few showers late Saturday, more Sunday
subtitle: HAPPENING NOW: Bright and breezy today, with morning 40s and 50s climbing to highs near 70 to the mid-70s. Winds from the north may gust to near 25 mph.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Brighter and breezy today, with morning 50s climbing to highs near 70 to the mid-70s. Winds from the north may gust to near 25 mph.

What's next? Highs around 70 to 75 on a decent Saturday, then cooler Sunday. Winds stay breezy, and a nearby coastal system brings an increasing shower risk from late Saturday into Sunday. Partial sun returns to start next week before warmth builds back in.

Today’s daily digit — 7/10: Mainly bright but breezy. Still, it’s plenty comfortable with temperatures up a handful of degrees from yesterday. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Friday): Partly sunny and breezy, with winds gusting from the north around 25 mph. Afternoon highs should reach 70 to the mid-70s. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: Mostly clear. Lows range from near 50 in the cooler spots to the mid- or upper 50s in DC. Winds continue from the north near 10 mph, with gusts around 20 mph. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Saturday): It should lean sunnier than not, but some clouds and even a few showers — especially east and northeast of DC — are increasingly possible late in the day. It stays breezy, with winds from the northwest gusting as high as about 30 mph. Highs again near 70 to the mid-70s. Confidence: Medium

Tomorrow night: Mostly cloudy, with a chance of showers rotating in from the northeast. The best odds remain northeast of DC, but the whole area could see some rain. Lows within a few degrees of 55. Confidence: Medium

Sunday: Some showers are possible, especially early in the morning and perhaps again in the afternoon or evening. Otherwise, expect mainly cloudy skies and continued gusts to near 30 mph. It may not be the best outdoor day. Highs likely stay in the 60s unless skies trend sunnier. Confidence: Low-Medium

A look ahead

Sunday night: Showers are possible before tapering off late. Mostly cloudy skies continue, with winds hopefully easing. Lows in the 50s to near 60. Confidence: Low-Medium

More clouds than sun and cooler air may linger into Monday, with highs potentially held within a few degrees of 70. Confidence: Medium

Sunshine and warmth build back in by Tuesday and Wednesday, with highs rising from the mid- to upper 70s Tuesday to the upper 70s to around 80 Wednesday. Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for September 25

Remnants of Hurricane Eloise in 1975 brought a deluge that set a rainfall record, flooded homes and roads, and forced evacuations across the region.
